host: Windows local Dev01; Chrome against Bluent InteractiveServer TextField showcase

directKeyEntry.evidence: Actual Windows key events translated to Persian glyphs while the native Persian layout was active.

scopeAndLimits.proved: Native Windows Persian keyboard-layout translation, beforeinput/input event data, Persian normalization and caret collapse after replacing a selected character.
scopeAndLimits.setupNote: The Arabic precondition string was inserted through the DOM value setter for a deterministic selection/normalization test; the replacement character itself was entered by a real OS-layout key event, not Unicode injection.
scopeAndLimits.notProved: IME candidate/composition lifecycle; no compositionstart, compositionupdate or compositionend was raised for the standard Persian keyboard layout. This is direct keyboard-layout input, not a composition-based IME.
